title: POSIX Engram fixture preserves padded project identity that the declaration trims
outcome: The POSIX Engram test fixture and its declaration agree on normalized project identity, including whitespace-padded fixture values, while genuinely different store/project identities are still refused.
acceptance: A deterministic POSIX fixture control reproduces the padded identity mismatch in engram_mcp_home_alias_keeps_the_current_store_authority on the unmodified fixture.
The POSIX fixture and Windows fixture use equivalent identity normalization, the existing alias/current-store authority control passes, and a genuinely mismatched identity is still refused.
